Description.SourceString:
Observation log: Ugh. I am afraid there are elves here, Sir. Why does it always have to be elves?

As expected, they have taken on the mantle of nemeses. No matter our disguise - whether it's a canoe, fairy ring or baby elf - they see right through it with their annoying eyes. We have tried everything: holding our breath, stacking penguins on top of each other, and even wearing green suits and applying after-effects. None of them work. 

Worst still, Sir, they dabble in smuggery. If they just pointed and said "spotted you", it wouldn't be half as bad. But no: they gather other elves around and have a hearty chuckle. 

One day we will come upon a new continent, rife for invasion and subterfuge, and there will be no elves there. What a glorious day it will be. 

Threat assessment: Extreme - their smuggery knows no bounds.

End of report.

- Agent Ravioli
